feedback_summary: The candidate captures all relevant data points and rankings from the chart. However, the response heavily incorporates external knowledge, scientific commentary (CO2, SO2, greenhouse effects, radiation), and moral advice not present in the visual stimulus, triggering the mandatory 60% hard cap for Graph/Chart tasks. Language mechanics also require improvement regarding spelling, subject-verb agreement, and comparative phrasing.
